title_en: Chinese History (3/20): Confucius Travels Among the States
note_en: 无论 … 都 … means "no matter …, still …": 无论出身贵贱，每个人都应该有机会接受教育 "whatever their birth, high or low, everyone should have a chance to be educated." 无论 sweeps away every condition at once, and 都 in the second half confirms the result holds for all of them; unlike English "no matter," the 都 is not optional. The text uses it again: 无论对象是谁，都可以从别人身上学到东西.
